title: quantity — recruit

phrases.translation: 订货量；订购量；订单数量

sentences.sentence: Your work has improved in quantity and quality this term.
sentences.translation: 这学期你的作业在完成数量和质量上都有提高。

sentences.sentence: Ray glanced at his watch and quickened his pace (= began to walk faster ).
sentences.translation: 雷瞥了一眼手表，加快了步伐。

sentences.sentence: Companies are finding it hard to cope with the quickening pace of technological change.
sentences.translation: 各家公司都发现科技的日新月异让他们难以应付。

phrases.translation: n. 配额制；定额分配制
生产指标；生产限额；生产配额；生产预计额
销售配额；销售限额；目标销售额

sentences.sentence: The government has decided to scrap quotas on car imports.
sentences.translation: 政府决定取消汽车进口配额。

sentences.sentence: There are plans to introduce strict immigration quotas.
sentences.translation: 有计划要推行严格的移民限额制度。

sentences.sentence: He quoted a short passage from the Bible.
sentences.translation: 他引用了《圣经》里的一小段。

sentences.sentence: A military spokesman was quoted as saying that the border area is now safe.
sentences.translation: 报道引述军方一位发言人的话，说边境地区现在很安全。

phrases.translation: 赛前动员会，鼓舞士气的集会

sentences.sentence: About 1,000 people attended the rally in Hyde Park.
sentences.translation: 大约有1,000人参加了海德公园的集会。

sentences.sentence: We decided to hold a rally to put pressure on the government.
sentences.translation: 我们决定举行集会来对政府施压。

sentences.sentence: a mass rally (= large rally ) in support of the pay claim
sentences.translation: 支持加薪要求的大型集会

sentences.sentence: They throw out all of these behaviors randomly.
sentences.translation: 它们的这些行为都是随机的。

sentences.sentence: It mimics a memory leak by randomly placing some of these arrays (~20% of them) into a list.
sentences.translation: 它通过随机将这些数组的一部分（大约 20%）放入一个列表来模拟内存泄漏。

phrases.translation: n. 民众，老百姓；普通士兵，普通成员
n. 前列；最重要；最突出；最好

sentences.sentence: There were several pairs of riding boots ranked neatly in the hall.
sentences.translation: 门厅里整齐地摆放着几双马靴。

sentences.sentence: Police are investigating a series of violent rapes in the town.
sentences.translation: 警察在调查镇上发生的一连串暴力强奸案。

sentences.sentence: He was arrested and charged with rape.
sentences.translation: 他被捕并被控强奸。

sentences.sentence: He always denied that he was guilty of rape.
sentences.translation: 他一直否认自己犯有强奸罪。

sentences.sentence: a rape victim
sentences.translation: 遭强奸者

sentences.sentence: the gang rape of a 17-year-old girl
sentences.translation: 对一个17岁少女的轮奸

sentences.sentence: He was convicted of attempted rape .
sentences.translation: 他被判犯有强奸未遂罪。

sentences.sentence: This species of plant is becoming increasingly rare.
sentences.translation: 这种植物越来越罕见。

sentences.sentence: I only saw Helen on the rare occasions when I went into her shop.
sentences.translation: 我只有偶尔去海伦店里时才会见到她。

sentences.sentence: It is very rare for her to miss a day at school.
sentences.translation: 她很少有哪一天不上学的。

phrases.translation: 应变速率；应变率；变形速度

sentences.sentence: $20 an hour is the going rate (= the usual amount paid ) for private tuition.
sentences.translation: 每小时20美元是私人授课的一般收费。

sentences.sentence: the spiritual realm
sentences.translation: 精神领域

sentences.sentence: The peasants leaned down to reap wheat.
sentences.translation: 农民们俯身收割小麦。

sentences.sentence: You don’t happen to recall his name, do you?
sentences.translation: 你不会恰巧还想得起他的名字吧？

sentences.sentence: As I recall, it was you who suggested this idea in the first place.
sentences.translation: 我记得，是你首先提出这个想法的。

sentences.sentence: She was unsure of her reception after everything that had happened.
sentences.translation: 发生了这些事后，她对自己是否还受欢迎没把握。

sentences.sentence: The plans received a mixed reception from unions (= some people liked them, others did not ) .
sentences.translation: 各工会对这些计划反响不一。

sentences.sentence: a recipe book
sentences.translation: 一本烹饪书

sentences.sentence: He was accused of causing death by reckless driving .
sentences.translation: 他被控因鲁莽驾驶致人死亡。

sentences.sentence: a reckless disregard for safety
sentences.translation: 不顾安全的鲁莽行为

sentences.sentence: He ran into the burning house with reckless abandon (= without caring about the danger ) .
sentences.translation: 他不顾危险冲入着火的房子里。

phrases.translation: 处理；对付；和…算帐；预料到

sentences.sentence: ‘There’s nothing we can do about it.’ ‘You reckon (= used to express doubt or disagreement ) ?’
sentences.translation: “这件事我们无能为力。”“是吗？”

sentences.sentence: The possibility remains that the two theories may be reconciled.
sentences.translation: 这两种理论仍是有可能协调的。

sentences.sentence: We’re having difficulty recruiting enough qualified staff.
sentences.translation: 我们难以招聘到足够的合格职员。

sentences.sentence: Many government officials were recruited from private industry.
sentences.translation: 很多政府官员是从私营企业招募来的。

text:
英语词汇 · 六级 · 第 30 单元

quantity
音标：英 /ˈkwɒntəti/  美 /'kwɑntəti/
n. 数量
短语：quantity of — 数量；流量
短语：large quantity — 大量；大数量
短语：quality and quantity — 质量和数量
短语：in quantity — 大量
短语：quantity in — 进货数量
短语：a large quantity of — adj. 大量的
短语：small quantity — 小量，少量
短语：order quantity — 订货量；订购量；订单数量
短语：quantity of heat — 热量
短语：a great quantity of — （接可数或不可数）大量
短语：air quantity — 气容量；通风量
短语：a small quantity of — 少量的
短语：physical quantity — 物理量
短语：quantities of — 许多……
短语：production quantity — 生产量
短语：quantity of information — 信息的量
短语：heat quantity — 热量
短语：quantity discount — 数量折扣，大批量折扣
短语：electric quantity — 电量
短语：an unknown quantity — 难预测的事；未知量
例句：Your work has improved in quantity and quality this term.
这学期你的作业在完成数量和质量上都有提高。

quicken
音标：英 /'kwɪkən/  美 /'kwɪkən/
v. 加快
短语：quicken up — 加速
例句：Ray glanced at his watch and quickened his pace (= began to walk faster ).
雷瞥了一眼手表，加快了步伐。
例句：Companies are finding it hard to cope with the quickening pace of technological change.
各家公司都发现科技的日新月异让他们难以应付。

quota
音标：英 /ˈkwəutə/  美 /'kwotə/
n. 配额，销售额
短语：quota system — n. 配额制；定额分配制
短语：quota management — 定额管理；配额管理
短语：above quota — 超额
短语：export quota — 出口配额，输出限额
短语：import quota — 输入限额
短语：production quota — 生产指标；生产限额；生产配额；生产预计额
短语：tariff quota — 关税配额
短语：quota control — 配额管制，配额控制
短语：sales quota — 销售配额；销售限额；目标销售额
短语：credit quota — 信贷规模
例句：The government has decided to scrap quotas on car imports.
政府决定取消汽车进口配额。
例句：There are plans to introduce strict immigration quotas.
有计划要推行严格的移民限额制度。

quote
音标：英 /kwəʊt/  美 /kwot/
v. 引用
短语：quote from — 引用自
短语：stock quote — 股票报价
例句：He quoted a short passage from the Bible.
他引用了《圣经》里的一小段。
例句：A military spokesman was quoted as saying that the border area is now safe.
报道引述军方一位发言人的话，说边境地区现在很安全。

rally
音标：英 /'rælɪ/  美 /'ræli/
n. 集会
短语：(hold a) rally — 团结；（举行）集会
短语：pep rally — 赛前动员会，鼓舞士气的集会
短语：rally point — 集结点
例句：About 1,000 people attended the rally in Hyde Park.
大约有1,000人参加了海德公园的集会。
例句：We decided to hold a rally to put pressure on the government.
我们决定举行集会来对政府施压。
例句：a mass rally (= large rally ) in support of the pay claim
支持加薪要求的大型集会

randomly
音标：英 /'rændəmlɪ/  美 /'rændəmlɪ/
adv. 随机地
例句：They throw out all of these behaviors randomly.
它们的这些行为都是随机的。
例句：It mimics a memory leak by randomly placing some of these arrays (~20% of them) into a list.
它通过随机将这些数组的一部分（大约 20%）放入一个列表来模拟内存泄漏。

rank
音标：英 /ræŋk/  美 /ræŋk/
v. 排列，分级
短语：in the ranks — 当兵，当战士
短语：in rank — 成行列；成队列
短语：first rank — 一流的
短语：rank among — 跻身于…；属于…之列
短语：rank first — 名列第一
短语：rank and file — n. 民众，老百姓；普通士兵，普通成员
短语：in the front rank — 著名；在前列
短语：front rank — n. 前列；最重要；最突出；最好
短语：rank with — 与……并列
短语：military rank — 军衔；军阶
短语：rank order — 等级次序
短语：social rank — 社会等级
短语：other ranks — (武装部队)非被委任的军官
短语：keep rank — 保持队形
短语：rank correlation — [经]等级相关；秩相关
例句：There were several pairs of riding boots ranked neatly in the hall.
门厅里整齐地摆放着几双马靴。

rape
音标：英 /reɪp/  美 /rep/
n. 强奸
短语：rape oil — n. 菜油
短语：rape seed — 油菜籽
短语：gang rape — 轮奸
短语：statutory rape — 法定强奸罪
例句：Police are investigating a series of violent rapes in the town.
警察在调查镇上发生的一连串暴力强奸案。
例句：He was arrested and charged with rape.
他被捕并被控强奸。
例句：He always denied that he was guilty of rape.
他一直否认自己犯有强奸罪。
例句：a rape victim
遭强奸者
例句：the gang rape of a 17-year-old girl
对一个17岁少女的轮奸
例句：He was convicted of attempted rape .
他被判犯有强奸未遂罪。

rare
音标：英 /reə(r)/  美 /rɛr/
adj. 罕见的，稀少的
短语：rare earth — 稀土元素的氧化物
短语：rare and — [英国方言] 非常，极
短语：rare opportunity — 稀有机会，难得机会
短语：rare earth element — [化]稀土元素
短语：rare metal — 稀有金属
短语：rare earth metal — 稀土金属
短语：rare old — [口语]极度的，非常的
短语：rare animal — 稀有动物
短语：rare earth oxide — 稀土氧化物；氧化稀土
短语：rare book — 珍本书，善本
短语：rare plant — 稀有植物；珍奇植物
短语：rare bird — 珍品；稀有之人或物
短语：rare breed — 凤毛麟角；稀有品种
短语：rare gas — 稀有气体
短语：medium rare — 四分熟
例句：This species of plant is becoming increasingly rare.
这种植物越来越罕见。
例句：I only saw Helen on the rare occasions when I went into her shop.
我只有偶尔去海伦店里时才会见到她。
例句：It is very rare for her to miss a day at school.
她很少有哪一天不上学的。

rate
音标：英 /reɪt/  美 /ret/
n. 费用
短语：exchange rate — 汇率；兑换率
短语：interest rate — [经]利率
短语：growth rate — 增长率；生长速率
短语：flow rate — 流量；流速
短语：recovery rate — 恢复速率
短语：survival rate — 存活率
短语：utilization rate — 使用率；利用率
短语：high rate — 高速率；高效率
短语：heart rate — 心率
短语：success rate — 成功率；接通率
短语：production rate — 生产率
短语：at any rate — 无论如何，至少
短语：discount rate — [经]贴现率
短语：at the rate of — 按…之速度；按...比率
短语：unemployment rate — 失业率
短语：tax rate — 税率
短语：strain rate — 应变速率；应变率；变形速度
短语：reaction rate — [化]反应速率
短语：error rate — 误码率；出错率
短语：death rate — 死亡率
例句：$20 an hour is the going rate (= the usual amount paid ) for private tuition.
每小时20美元是私人授课的一般收费。

realm
音标：英 /relm/  美 /rɛlm/
n. 领域，方面
短语：in the realm of — 在……领域里
例句：the spiritual realm
精神领域

reap
音标：英 /ri:p/  美 /rip/
v. 收割，收货
短语：reap the benefits of — 获得益处
例句：The peasants leaned down to reap wheat.
农民们俯身收割小麦。

recall
音标：英 /rɪ'kɔ:l/  美 /'rikɔl/
v. 回忆起，想起
短语：beyond recall — 不可挽回；不能记起
短语：recall from — 从…处召回
短语：recall to mind — 回想起，回忆起，记得
短语：recall ratio — 查全率，检索率
例句：You don’t happen to recall his name, do you?
你不会恰巧还想得起他的名字吧？
例句：As I recall, it was you who suggested this idea in the first place.
我记得，是你首先提出这个想法的。

receipt
音标：英 /rɪ'si:t/  美 /rɪ'sit/
n. 发票
短语：on receipt of — 在收到…后
短语：official receipt — 正式收据
短语：acknowledge receipt — 证实收到
短语：acknowledge receipt of — 收到
短语：in receipt of — 已收到…
短语：deposit receipt — 存单，存款收据
短语：warehouse receipt — 仓单；栈单；仓库收据
短语：courier receipt — 专递收据；快邮收据
短语：trust receipt — 信托收据
短语：tax receipt — 税单；报税收据
短语：place of receipt — 收货地；收货地点
短语：return receipt — 回执
短语：cargo receipt — 货运收据
短语：goods receipt — 货物收据
短语：acknowledgement of receipt — 回执，接收确认
短语：bank receipt — 水单；银行收据

reception
音标：英 /rɪˈsepʃn/  美 /rɪ'sɛpʃən/
n. 接待
短语：warm reception — 热情接待
短语：reception desk — 接待处（等于front desk）
短语：reception area — 接待处；接待室
短语：reception room — 会客室，接待室
短语：wedding reception — 结婚宴会，婚宴
短语：reception centre — n. 接待处
例句：She was unsure of her reception after everything that had happened.
发生了这些事后，她对自己是否还受欢迎没把握。
例句：The plans received a mixed reception from unions (= some people liked them, others did not ) .
各工会对这些计划反响不一。

recipe
音标：英 /'resəpɪ/  美 /'rɛsəpi/
n. 秘方，食谱
短语：secret recipe — 秘方；秘密配方
短语：recipe for disaster — 造成灾难的因素
短语：formulating of recipe — 配方设计
短语：recipe book — 配方书；食谱书
例句：a recipe book
一本烹饪书

reckless
音标：英 /'rekləs/  美 /'rɛkləs/
adj. 鲁莽的
短语：reckless driving — 鲁莽驾驶；驾驶疏忽
例句：He was accused of causing death by reckless driving .
他被控因鲁莽驾驶致人死亡。
例句：a reckless disregard for safety
不顾安全的鲁莽行为
例句：He ran into the burning house with reckless abandon (= without caring about the danger ) .
他不顾危险冲入着火的房子里。

reckon
音标：英 /'rekən/  美 /'rɛkən/
v. 认为，评价
短语：reckon with — 处理；对付；和…算帐；预料到
短语：reckon on — 指望；依赖
短语：reckon in — 把…计算在内
短语：reckon up — 计算；合计
例句：‘There’s nothing we can do about it.’ ‘You reckon (= used to express doubt or disagreement ) ?’
“这件事我们无能为力。”“是吗？”

reconcile
音标：英 /'rekənsaɪl/  美 /'rɛkənsaɪl/
v. 使和解，使一致；调解
短语：reconcile with — 与…和解
例句：The possibility remains that the two theories may be reconciled.
这两种理论仍是有可能协调的。

recruit
音标：英 /rɪ'kru:t/  美 /rɪ'krut/
v. 招聘
例句：We’re having difficulty recruiting enough qualified staff.
我们难以招聘到足够的合格职员。
例句：Many government officials were recruited from private industry.
很多政府官员是从私营企业招募来的。
